status: Unpublished proposal; no website files changed
name: Kreativ Font
accessLabel: Free app; linked fonts have separate licences
description: Discover typefaces for design projects, search font articles and save a shortlist on your Android phone.
features: Browse separate commercial and free font sections, with Load 10 more
Search the full website catalogue with All, Commercial and Free filters
Inspect original website artwork with full-screen zoom and pan
Save font articles without an account and search favourites on the device
proDescription: The native app is free, with no optional Pro tier. Font purchases and downloads are handled by linked websites under their own prices and licences. A Free label does not guarantee unrestricted commercial use.
privacyNote: Online catalogue searches send your phrase to kreativfont.com; request URLs can appear in hosting logs. Favourites and favourites search stay on the device. Browser visits follow destination-site terms.
limitation: Not a phone-font installer, text editor, font identifier or custom-text tester. Current catalogue access needs internet. Offline artwork depends on cache. Uninstalling or clearing storage removes favourites, with no cloud sync or account recovery. The interface and articles are English.
screenshotSource: Keep the existing genuine website app screenshot unless a specific replacement is approved. Do not substitute a framed listing layout into the responsive screenshot pipeline.
